retrievalProfile.description: A soft-focus, warm-toned portrait featuring a central figure in lace, framed by high-contrast display serifs and elegant script.
excludeWhen: sharp modern digital photography is required
cool-toned or high-saturation color palettes are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A dreamy, low-contrast photograph of a woman with blonde hair wearing white lace, set against a pale, warm-toned background. The composition is anchored by two distinct typographic styles: a heavy, wide serif at the top left and a flowing, slanted script at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Soft-focus subject vs. sharp black typography
Warm cream background vs. cool white lace textures
Heavy geometric serif vs. delicate organic script
Off-center subject placement vs. balanced text blocks
coreInvariants: High-contrast black ink for all typographic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot of a figure positioned slightly right of center, occupying approximately 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and crossed arms form the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the heavy top-left text, move down to the subject's face, and follow the curve of the lace to the bottom script.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space on the left side to accommodate the display typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high key values; the image feels washed out and airy.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Combination of ultra-bold extended serif and elegant formal script.
letterConstructionRules: Top text: Extreme horizontal expansion with hairline serifs and thick stems.
Bottom text: 30-degree slant, high stroke contrast, and looped terminals.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a heavy, masculine geometric serif and a light, feminine organic script.

preserve: Horizontal expansion of the top font
Slant and contrast of the bottom script

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Extended Modern Serif (e.g., Karloff Positive, Thorowgood)
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme weight and horizontal stretch of the top text.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Formal Calligraphic Script (e.g., Snell Roundhand, Shelley Volante)
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the elegant, slanted, high-contrast flow of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus, grainy photograph of a woman with long blonde hair wearing a white lace shawl, tinted with a warm peach/cream wash, leaving negative space on the left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply two lines of ultra-bold extended serif text in the top left and one line of large, elegant script text across the bottom, both in solid black.

verificationChecks: Is the photography soft-focus and grainy?
Is the top font extremely wide and heavy?
Is the bottom font a slanted, high-contrast script?
Is the overall color palette warm and desaturated?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the warm color tint
Degree of font expansion for the top text

mustAchieve: Textural contrast between lace and skin

postGenerationChecks: Check that the script text is legible against the lace background.
Ensure the top-left text does not crowd the subject's face.
Verify the warm tint is consistent across the entire frame.
Confirm the grain texture feels like film, not digital noise.
recipe.reuseFormula: Soft-focus portrait + Warm peach wash + (Ultra-bold Extended Serif / Elegant Script) pairing.
